title: ArchitectureConfig
description: declarative architecture configuration for grimuah, defines surfaces, edge rules, depth ordering, dag ordering, and rule layer toggles

sourceRoots.description: repo-relative directories the lint walk starts from. a file outside every root is not linted

surfaces.description: ordered list of surfaces, each with physical depth and DAG order for the import graph topology

name.description: logical name of the surface, used in edge rules and error messages

path.description: filesystem path relative to project root (e.g. 'src/services')

depth.description: filesystem nesting depth: 0 for root-level directories (e.g. lib/), 1 for items under src/, etc.

dagOrder.description: ordering in the DAG: lower values are shallower in the import graph. surfaces with higher dagOrder can import from surfaces with lower dagOrder. surfaces at the same dagOrder may not freely import from each other without explicit allowedImports.

suffixes.description: legal file suffixes for this surface, files not matching any suffix are flagged as Cosmetic violations

innateMembers.description: suffixes that can exist in any surface but inherit that surface's depth (e.g. '.types.ts', '.config.ts', '.spec.ts', '.regex-patterns.ts')

allowedImports.description: names of surfaces this surface may import from, any import from a surface not in this list is a Structural violation

layers.description: independently toggleable rule layers, each controls a category of lint enforcement

cosmetic.description: surface-level readability: folder-as-suffix naming, no em-dashes, no centralized config/types/models directories

structural.description: graph integrity: import firewall, dag ordering, singleton folder warnings, innate member scoping

resilience.description: change-proofing: enum over magic string, const over let, readonly, dispatch tables, declarative patterns, explicit types, self-documenting names, no proxy re-exports

behavioural.description: runtime safety: no throw (OperationOutcome pattern), input validation at boundaries, no bare catch

rules.description: per-rule toggles, a rule runs unless the config names it false. every rule of the table the enabled layers carry is on by default, and the surface and edge model itself is not a rule: it cannot be turned off here

em-dash.description: cosmetic layer: do not use em-dashes; use commas, colons, or sentence breaks instead

null-literal.description: resilience layer: do not use null; use undefined. null only at third-party boundaries (DB, RegExp)

let-declaration.description: resilience layer: do not use let; use const. only let at module-level mutable caches

switch-statement.description: resilience layer: do not use switch; use a dispatch table (Record/Map) instead

imperative-for-loop.description: resilience layer: do not use imperative for loops; use map, filter, reduce, or for..of instead

loose-equality.description: resilience layer: use === instead of == to avoid type coercion bugs

as-any.description: resilience layer: 'as any' bypasses type safety entirely; use a proper type instead

any-type.description: resilience layer: This `any` type bypasses type safety. Write the type you mean instead.

chained-cast.description: resilience layer: chained 'as' casts bypass type safety; use a single cast only

proxy-reexport.description: resilience layer: do not proxy re-export; every export must originate from the file that defines it

as-const.description: resilience layer: use enum instead of const + as const; enum gives you both value and type in one declaration

throw-statement.description: behavioural layer: do not use throw; all errors must flow through OperationOutcome. see lib/outcome.ts

bare-catch.description: behavioural layer: do not use bare catch with silent failure; log the error or return an Outcome

silent-catch.description: behavioural layer: catch block must handle or log the error, not silently discard it

max-nesting-depth.description: resilience layer: This block is nested N levels deep. Return early or extract a helper.

max-parameters.description: resilience layer: This function takes N parameters. Group them into a named readonly type, or split the function.

lowercase-copy.description: cosmetic layer: This copy starts lowercase. Capitalise the first letter of the sentence.

boolean-flag-argument.description: resilience layer: This call passes a bare boolean literal. Name the behaviour instead, or pass a named enum value.

max-function-lines.description: resilience layer: This function body is N lines long. Extract each distinct job into a named function.

nested-ternary.description: resilience layer: This conditional expression contains another conditional expression. Extract the inner decision into a named helper or a lookup.

max-file-lines.description: resilience layer: This file is N lines long. Split it along the responsibilities its sections already show.

await-in-loop.description: behavioural layer: This loop awaits inside its body, so every iteration runs in sequence. Map the items to promises and await Promise.all once.

max-cyclomatic-complexity.description: resilience layer: This function has a cyclomatic complexity of N. Extract each decision into a named predicate or a lookup.

unbounded-collection-read.description: resilience layer: This query reads a collection with no LIMIT, so it returns every matching row. Add an explicit LIMIT and paginate when the caller needs everything.

for-of-accumulation.description: resilience layer: This for..of loop builds an array by pushing into it. Use map, filter, flatMap or reduce instead.

config-behaviour.description: structural layer: This .config.ts file declares a function. Move the behaviour into the surface's own module.

if-chain-dispatch.description: resilience layer: These N branches dispatch on one subject. Declare a Record or Map from the subject's value to the handler.

literal-union-enum.description: resilience layer: This union of N string literals carries no runtime value. Declare a string enum and use its members as the discriminant.

optional-property.description: resilience layer: This property is optional. Make it required and default it at the boundary, or model the states as a discriminated union.

readonly-collection-signature.description: resilience layer: This signature hands over a mutable array. Declare it as `readonly T[]` or `ReadonlyArray<T>`.

readonly-type-member.description: resilience layer: This property is mutable. Add `readonly`, and build a new object when a layer needs a changed copy.

scalar-failure-return.description: resilience layer: This async operation reports its failure as a bare boolean or number, so a caller cannot tell the answer from the error. Return an outcome value that names the failure reason.

discarded-outcome.description: behavioural layer: This call returns an Outcome and nothing reads the result, so its failure branch is unreachable. Assign the result and narrow `succeeded`, or log the failure where the call is best effort.

unread-scalar-result.description: behavioural layer: This call's declared result is a bare boolean or number and nothing reads it, so the failure channel exists only in the signature. Read the result and act on it, or narrow the callee to a `void` result.

enum-placement.description: structural layer: This enum is a configuration constant declared in an implementation module. Move it to the surface's .config.ts file.

import-cycle.description: structural layer: This import closes a cycle: the file it names imports back into this one, so module initialisation order decides what this file sees. Lift the shared symbols into a module at or above the shallower of the two, or invert one direction with a callback.

redundant-allowed-import.description: structural layer: Surface 'name' (dagOrder N) grants 'name' (dagOrder N), which the dag already permits. Delete the entry from its allowedImports list.

shared-type-placement.description: structural layer: This type is imported from another directory, so this module's behaviour is coupled to it. Declare it in name.types.ts instead.

export-without-consumer.description: structural layer: `name` is exported but no other module names it. Drop the `export` keyword, or have another module name it.

duplicated-function-body.description: resilience layer: `name` has a byte-identical body in another file. Lift the implementation into one shared declaration and import it from both call sites.

duplicated-statement-text.description: resilience layer: This statement is written more than once in the run. Declare it once as a module-level constant, or as one exported helper both call sites call.

duplicated-user-facing-copy.description: cosmetic layer: This sentence is written in three or more files. Declare it once in the owning surface's `.config.ts` and import it, or lift it to the shared module when several surfaces need it.

repeated-inline-copy.description: cosmetic layer: This sentence is written more than once in this file. Declare it once as a module-level constant, or as an entry in the owning `.config.ts`, and name it at both sites.

literal-duplicating-config-value.description: cosmetic layer: This literal duplicates `name`, which the surface's own `.config.ts` already declares. Reference the enum member instead.

duplicated-computation.description: resilience layer: This computation is written in N other files. Extract it into a shared function both call sites import.

unused-import.description: hygiene layer: This import is unused.

unused-variable.description: hygiene layer: This variable name is unused.

prefer-const.description: hygiene layer: This let declares a variable that is only assigned once.

constant-condition.description: hygiene layer: This condition always evaluates to the same value.

unreachable-code.description: hygiene layer: This code will never be reached.

rootLib.description: optional root-level lib/ surface at depth 0, shallower than everything in src/

enabled.description: whether a root-level lib/ directory exists alongside src/

path.description: path to the root lib directory (default: 'lib')
